description: Mixture-of-Softmaxes BitReadout (T=8 NAP=15 popcount experts, gated, multimodal) + COLD-START FIX. exp547 crawled because each expert init'd near-uniform (scale 1/sqrt(15)) and averaging T of them is flatter still (weak gradient) + each expert gets only 1/T of the signal early. Fix: mix_scale_init=0.6 (peaked experts -> real gradient) + head_lr=3e-3 (10x). The mixture is the goal (flat BitReadout collapses to ONE association; this keeps T separate experts -> multimodal). vs exp513 Linear 1.4825/1.4656; exp548 flat baseline running in parallel.
